headline: Chile Finance Minister Estimates $700 Million Cost to End Trucker Strike
summary: Chilean Finance Minister Jorge Quiroz estimated a $700 million fiscal cost arising from policy concessions made to resolve a nationwide strike by truck drivers over fuel prices. The sector comprises roughly 230,000 trucks and 90,000 transport firms.
why: Chile's road transport sector moves essential exports including copper and agricultural products across South America's fifth-largest economy.

impacts.name: Chile
impacts.why: Unbudgeted $700 million fiscal concessions to truckers expand Chile's fiscal spending.
